stem.text: Two trolleys are held together on a horizontal surface with a compressed spring between them.

stem.alt: Two trolleys on a horizontal surface with a spring between them; the left trolley is labelled 2 kg and the right trolley is labelled 1 kg.

stem.text: When they are released, the trolleys lose contact with the spring. The trolley of mass $2\,\text{kg}$ moves to the left at a final speed of $2\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
How much elastic potential energy was stored in the spring?
